episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: TV newswoman Anna returns to her small Georgia hometown to report on a murder case, in which her estranged husband Jack is the lead investigator.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Jack and Priya try to poke holes in a key suspect's alibi. Anna returns to her alma mater for a contentious interview with an old classmate.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Anna jumps at a chance to return to the anchor desk. Zoe confronts Jack about what he's been hiding. Alice's decline forces some tough conversations.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Jack struggles to placate the locals at a fiery town hall. Priya's suspicions reach a breaking point. Anna is haunted by painful memories.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Backed into a corner, Jack grows increasingly erratic. Anna finds herself on the opposite side of an interview. Richard's past comes to light.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: As the case comes to a close, Jack and Anna must reckon with the sins of the past — and the brutal consequences in the present.
